title: grover-tax fixture v0.3-iadd
description: Schema for fixtures/v0.3-<circuit>-k<K>-n<N>.json — the repeated-addition (Khattar/Google) workload (KB-4 #116, KB-15 #127). The fixture stores GTV1 bytes of ONE adder repetition; `repetitions` records K and the prover sides loop the gate list K times per test case in-proof (mirroring upstream, whose guest receives the circuit once plus num_repetitions). Test cases are register-aware two-register pairs (x, y) -> ((x + K*y) mod 2^width, y). Tier-1 cases are SUPPLIED (deterministic), not in-proof Fiat-Shamir-derived (KB-9, #121). Commitment policy: kmx_source_sha256 is over the RAW .kmx bytes (cross-comparable with upstream sha256(<circuit>.kmx)); circuit_commitment_* are over OUR GTV1 bytes of the single stored repetition (internal integrity). See docs/spec/v0.3/COMMITMENT-POLICY.md.

version.description: Fixture-format version. Frozen at 'v0.3-iadd' for the repeated-addition workload series.

generator_commit.description: Repo SHA at generation time. Excluded from --check normalisation.

workload_pin_commit.description: Upstream zkp_ecc SHA the .kmx circuit was vendored from (supersedes WORKLOAD.md's v0.1 pin for the iadd workload until KB-5/#117 re-pins it).

seed_hex.description: sha256(SEED || sha256(kmx bytes) || K_le8 || N_le8) — 32 bytes, lowercase hex. Seeds the deterministic test-case XOF, binding the case stream to the exact circuit and (K, N) benchmark point (a step toward KB-9's in-proof Fiat-Shamir derivation).

tier.description: Scale-tier label (RFC-0024). The tier <-> repetition-count (K) mapping is refined in KB-7 (#119).

circuit_source.description: The upstream kickmix source circuit, executed `repetitions` times.

kmx_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the RAW single-repetition .kmx bytes. Cross-comparable with upstream's sha256(<circuit>.kmx). RECOMMENDED commitment for head-to-head comparison.

repetitions.description: K — how many times the prover executes the stored gate list per test case (the scaling knob). Repeated addition computes (x + K*y) mod 2^width. The stored circuit bytes hold ONE repetition.

register_layout.description: Register -> qubit-index layout recovered from APPEND_TO_REGISTER metadata (least-significant first).

register_width.description: Bit width of each adder register (number of qubits per register).

num_qubits.description: Total qubit count of the circuit (one past the largest qubit index). Equals the state-vector width in bits.

n_samples.description: Number of supplied test cases (upstream: shots). Must equal len(test_cases).

bit_stripe_width.description: Reversible-circuit bit-stripe width W (verbatim from upstream batching).

circuit_serialisation_format_version.description: Canonical serialisation format version. v0.3-iadd uses GTV1 (1) for the classical subset.

circuit_byte_serialisation_hex.description: Canonical GTV1 byte serialisation of ONE adder repetition, lowercase hex, even length. Provers execute these gates `repetitions` times per test case.

circuit_commitment_sha256_hex.description: sha256 over the stored single-repetition GTV1 bytes (SP1-side internal integrity).

circuit_commitment_blake2s_hex.description: blake2s over the stored single-repetition GTV1 bytes (Stwo-side internal integrity).

demanded_max_qubit_count.description: Forward-looking (Tier-2 / KB-10, #122): the qubit-count bound a resource-certifying verifier will assert (>= committed count).

demanded_max_non_clifford_count.description: Forward-looking: the non-Clifford (TOFFOLI/CCZ) gate-count bound across all K repetitions (upstream scales this by the repetition count: SCALED_TOFFOLI = TOFFOLI * nrep).

demanded_max_circuit_instructions.description: Forward-looking: the total-instruction bound across all K repetitions (gates-per-repetition * K).

demanded_num_samples.description: Forward-looking: the minimum sample count the verifier will demand (<= committed num_samples).

test_cases.description: Ordered list of register-aware adder cases. Iteration order is binding.

r0_in.description: Input accumulator register value x (unsigned residue in [0, 2^width)).

r1_in.description: Input offset register value y (unsigned residue in [0, 2^width)).

x_hex.description: Encoded input state (num_qubits bits, little-endian byte layout): r0:=x, r1:=y, ancillae zero.

y_hex.description: Expected output state after K repetitions of the stored circuit: r0:=(x + K*y) mod 2^width, r1:=y, ancillae zero.
